FORTISBC INC.
For the Year Ended December 31, 2023
The Corporation is serving approximately 190,000 electricity customers.
In September 2023, the BCUC issued its decision. The BCUC determined that FBC's deemed equity component of total capital structure and allowed ROE will change from 40 per cent and 9.15 per cent to 41 per cent and 9.65 per cent, respectively, effective January 1, 2023.
